instruction.name: vslti.w
instruction.description: Compare the signed 32-bit elements in `a` and the sign-extended `imm`, store all-ones to `dst` if corresponding element in `a` is less than `imm`, zero otherwise.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vslti.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vslti.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vslti.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vslti.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vslti.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vslti.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vslti.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vslti.w $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vslti.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vslti.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vslti.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vslti.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vslti.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vslti.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vslti.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vslti.w $vr7, $vr15, 1'
